doc.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 25, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe and Stripling thank each other and wrap up the recording.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Wow, well thank you, Byron. There’s some eloquent statements there, and I really appreciate your sharing your opinions.

What a joy to talk to you again. I want to just congratulate you and thank you for what you’re doing for the history of jazz, and that will be a document that you created along with your sponsors, that will outlive both of us, and I’m happy to see that.
Thank you. It has been a great gig for me, I’ll give you that.
Well you’re great at it. I was listening to the Loren Schoenburg interview, you’re great at it, so thank you.
Well I’m going to pause our recording, then we can just wrap up.
